app_fee.value: No application fee is stated for doctoral candidates; the only doctoral charge is the semester fee paid after enrollment, about EUR 155 per semester.
app_fee.quote: Although there are no specific fees for doctoral candidates, they must pay the semester fee twice a year

fee_waiver.value: There is no doctoral application fee, so no waiver applies.
fee_waiver.quote: Although there are no specific fees for doctoral candidates, they must pay the semester fee twice a year

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement is stated for doctoral applicants on the university pages checked.

toefl_min.value: No TOEFL minimum is stated for doctoral applicants on the university pages checked.

ielts_min.value: No IELTS minimum is stated for doctoral applicants on the university pages checked.

english_waiver.value: No English-medium or India rule is stated for doctoral applicants on the university pages checked.

notes: Doctoral admission is handled by each faculty's PhD office under its own doctoral regulations (PromO, German only). The university pages checked give no doctoral application fee, English test, GRE or English-medium waiver; the English rules found are for degree-seeking students. Department root pages for chemistry and biology redirect to a login page. Not covered here (separate school records): Graduate Training Centre of Neuroscience, the two International Max Planck Research Schools, LEAD. Not researched: Biochemistry and Pharmaceutics, both listed as Faculty of Science doctoral subjects; no department doctoral page was found.
